correctness.rationale: Hillar–Rhea representation gives a unique residue-matrix parametrization. Multiplication supplies four complete congruences. Their valuation cases and exact Z/p² product fibers cover every p and each b>a for a=1,2, with special calculations at b=3,4. The four sums algebraically simplify to the four claimed formulas, checked independently in 37 finite instances. These are finite crosschecks, not replacements for proof.

value.rationale: The quantity # {T in End(G):T²=0} is a natural endomorphism-monoid invariant measuring two-step collapse into the kernel. The infinite two-exponent families are motivated by the first two short lengths at which product fibers change, and the exact period-two stabilization is a structural feature of p-adic square valuations. Arbitrarily large b are included, and the shorter exponent-two result requires a qualitatively new product-fiber analysis; no downstream application is claimed as already proved.
